sections.content: Different times of day have specific names: 'reggel' (morning), 'délben' (at noon), 'este' (evening). Use these with 'van' to say when something happens.

items.english: On Monday morning we are at home.
At noon we eat lunch. (At noon we lunch.)

items.spanish: Jó nap volt. Holnap is találkozunk.
items.english: It was a good day. Tomorrow we also meet.

sections.content: 'Reggel' (morning), 'délben' (at noon), and 'este' (evening) are time adverbs. 'Holnap' (tomorrow) and 'hétfőn' (on Monday) position actions in time.
